blocks.text: Boxplots, yaani box-and-whisker plots, median, quartiles aur mumkina bahar wali qeematein (outliers) dikha kar taqseem ka khulasa karte hain, aur phailao ka tasveeri khulasa dete hain. Yeh groups ke muwazne, jaise mukhtalif classes ke exam scores, ke liye mufeed hain.

blocks.alt: Ufuqi box plot, unwan Box Plot of Exam Scores for Three Classes, Exam Scores 50 se 100. Class 1: box taqreeban 62 se 75, median taqreeban 69, ek oonchi outlier. Class 2: box taqreeban 68 se 78, median taqreeban 73, do oonchi outliers. Class 3: box taqreeban 72 se 85, median taqreeban 77, ek neechi aur ek oonchi outlier.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.8: Teen classes ki karkardagi dikhane wala boxplot (kitab ki Figure 5.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har box beech ke aadhe students dikhata hai (pehle quartile se teesre quartile tak), surkh lakeer median hai, dashed lakeerein (whiskers) baqi phailao aur chhote daire outliers. Class 3 ka median sab se ooncha hai, is liye us ki karkardagi behtar hai; Class 3 ka box sab se chaura bhi hai, yani us ke scores zyada phaile hain.

blocks.prompt: Class A aur Class B dono ka median 55 hai. Boxplot aisa kya dikhata hai jo median nahi dikhata?
blocks.explanation: Scores kitne phaile hain: Class B ka box aur whiskers kahin chaure hain, to us ke nataij kahin zyada badalte hain.

items: Boxplot: median, quartiles aur outliers; groups ke phailao ka muwazna.
